title: Great stand for the inept assembler, looks great!
text: Great stand for the inept assembler, looks great!. Let me begin by saying that I am a woman, who recently turned 60, and who is normally totally inept when it comes to putting these kinds of things together. However, since I had family coming for Thanksgiving (and a relatively small guest room), I thought I would try to put this together to see if I could open a little space in the room. Well, I did it! I was amazed at how easy this was to assemble. Sure, you needed screwdrivers (but I could handle that). I did need some help in attaching the television to the stand (not very coordinated or strong, either). But, I will say it made a major difference in the room. Besides freeing up some much needed space from the bulky stand I was previously using, it is very attractive and has room for 'storage' which makes it perfect. I am so happy with this and I know you will be, too.

description: Even the smallest of spaces can use an Ameriwood Home Galaxy TV Stand with Mount. Measuring in at a mere 49.0625"h x 29.5"w x 23.625"d, this unit is compact, but the mount can hold a 50” flat-screen television with a maximum weight of 70 lbs. Because of its small size, it’s great for apartments, family rooms, bedrooms, dorms and any other space that can utilize vertical storage. The floating shelf design features 2 fixed shelves, with 1 of them made of glass. Additionally, 2 cubbies along the spine of the stand are ideal for organizing DVDs and games. With a sleek black finish, this laminated MDF and particleboard TV stand boasts a modern style. Two people are required for proper assembly.

details.Care instructions: Dust and wipe with a dry cloth and if needed, a damp cloth may be used sparingly.
